Shine, mighty God, on Britain shine
Reveal thy power thro' all our coasts,
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 67, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah 2that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations. 3Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You. 4Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth.
